sampling_coverage.threshold_interpretation: Diagnostic counts only; validity masks and sampling are not altered.

limitations: Existing scenes have been inspected during development; no new independent final test set.
ROI classes are reference-derived heuristics, not manual labels.
Shared same-stream fixed-pattern bias is not independently removed by odd/even references.
No true dynamic target, no full-sequence temporal acceptance, no calibrated perceptual pass threshold.
Prediction/reference hashes checked; original RAW source size checked, full RAW hashes not recomputed.
MIS20S1 A3 training-reference-derived constructed targets; development diagnostic, not independent real dynamic or cross-sensor validation
Constructed global-translation boundaries are artificial and visible to the model; this is a mechanism probe, not an isolated proof of real-motion causality.
The first 200 updates are a pipeline pilot, not a multi-epoch or matched causal experiment.
